body:
Review pass 31. The scale gate is running now, and the live numbers change what Epic 8 should conclude.

  fixture ready          11:36:52
  observed               11:51:36
  measured elapsed       14 min 44 s    against a 30-minute gate   (49% consumed)
  worker process RSS     2.43 GiB       against a 4 GiB gate       (61%, process not incremental)
  worker CPU             12 min 26 s

That is half the time budget and most of the memory budget spent on the most favourable configuration the harness can present: q = 2, three partitions, six ordered edges, and a local covariance that is singular for 84% of supports (bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT).

THE INTERACTION IS THE POINT. Both fixes for the degeneracy multiply the dominant cost:
  observations 32 -> 200   residual accumulation is n*k^2 per support, about 6x
  partitions   3 -> 6      30 ordered edges instead of 6, about 5x, plus 2x accumulation
Either puts the run far outside 30 minutes. So dense local shrinkage at whole-brain scale does not appear to fit the gate at ANY statistically meaningful setting - the current fixture passes because it is degenerate, not because the path scales.

YOUR OWN ACCEPTANCE ALREADY ANTICIPATES THIS: "If dense local shrinkage misses the gate, version 0.1 supports brain-scale diagonal metrics and explicitly scopes dense metrics to smaller supports/node sets." That now looks like the correct outcome rather than a contingency.

Recommend Epic 8 conclude with an explicit scope statement - brain-scale diagonal metrics supported, dense local metrics scoped to a declared node count or support size - and that the gate be re-run at a non-degenerate fixture to find where the real boundary sits. Reporting a pass obtained where no searchlight can estimate a covariance would be the weakest possible version of this epic, and it is avoidable.

For context from earlier passes: the identity-metric path is genuinely comfortable at this scale - 166s end to end at 50k voxels after the p0 fix - so the scope split is between metric families, not between the package and brain scale.

I will report the completed gate numbers when the run finishes. Still open: bd-01KZXW5MFZGEXVJ3CMKMGBGFZX (MC test 1% headroom, unchanged).
